tasks.title: Implement the shout helper

tasks.deterministic_validity_check: node --experimental-default-type=module -e "import('./src/shout.js').then(({shout}) => { if (shout('wow!') !== 'WOW!!') throw new Error('invalid shout behavior'); })"
